A prompt Nymbot sends for you on a sched: He pūrongo Nymbot ka tuku atu mōu i runga i tētahi aho taketake. Whakaoho i ngā aho taketake o te tūmatanui i roto i ngā Tautoko (Settings), ā ka taea te whakamātau i ia tētahi ki te whakapā atu ki a koe i te wā e tae ana, te rere ranei i runga i te tūmatanui o Nymbot i te wā e tapatea ana te app. Ko ia rā mahi he utu whakautu, pēnei i tētahi mea atu.

He pūrongo Nymbot e tīmata ana mōu i runga i tētahi aho takatakiri. Kāore he tūrāpū e mahi ana i tēnei: e rere ana i te wā e tuwhera ana te tuhono, ā, he tūnga i tū i te wā i tūpato ana te tuhono ka huri i te wā i hoki mai koe i te mea kāore e whai i ngā katoa. Ko te tūnga katoa he utu whakautu, kia rite ki tētahi atu.

Ki te whakakore i te pātai, ki te muku i tētahi raupapa, me te muku i te app, ka muku tonu te kopia taputaki.

Ka puta he whakautu e rārangi ana i tētahi whārangi, he tuhi rānei, he pēhea rānei he tuhinga ki tētahi mata motuhake, kaua e neke noa i te takere. Whakatika i reira, ā, ka tūhono katoa ngā whakaaturanga hei whakamātau e taea te hoki mai. Connect as many repositories as you like: Whakawhono mai i ngā pātengi kōnae e pai ana koe, ā, kōwhiria ngā e taea te kitea e tēnei kōrerorero. Ko ngā kaitoha tino rangatira ka pānui i ā rātou kōdi, ā, ki te whakakā i te tuhituhi, ka whakautu, ka whakatakoto i ngā rārangi hou, ā, ka whakatuwhera i ngā tono pātenga hou. Ka tuku atu ngā tohu whakawhono ki te mahiira Nymbot i ia tono, ā, kāore e tiakina i te taha servera, ā, kāore hoki e whakaputa ki ngā pūkorei. Ki te whakakā i te whakakotahi, ka haere atu ki ō tērā atu taputapu i te wā e tiakina ana ki tō kī ake anake, ā, ki te whakamutu i tētahi i tētahi taputapu, ka whakamutua i ngā wā katoa.

Whakakotahi i ngā pātengi raraunga e pai ai koe, ā, tāmarki ngā mea ka kitea e tēnei kōrerorero. Ka pānui ngā whakautu Pro i ō rātou kōdi, ā, ki te whakatūpato te tuhituhi, ka whakamanahia (commit), ka whakatū rama (branch), ā, ka whakatuwhera mga pull request. Ka tuku atu ngā access token ki te mahi Nymbot i ia inenga, ā, e kore e tiaki i runga i te server mō te wā katoa, mō te tukuna rānei ki ngā relay. Ki te pai te sync, ka haere atu ki ō tātari anō e kapihia ana ki tō ake kī, ā, ki te whakakore i tētahi i runga i tētahi pūrere, ka whakakore atu ai i ngā wāhi katoa.

Ngā mea tika e whai ake nei e mau ana a Nymbot i waenganui i ngā kōrerorero: te ingoa e tiakina ana i a koe, te mahi e mahi nei koe, me te āhua e hiahia ana koe kia tuhia ai ngā whakautu. Inā oti, ka whakatuwheratia he tono whakakotahi (pull request), ka huri ki te whakakotahi (merge) me te tuku i te pāremata, e kōwhiri ana koe i raro i te "Ina oti" i roto i ngā Tūnga (Settings) mō ia pāremata rānei. Ko te whakautu e whakaatu ana i te pāremata me te Open PR, Merge me te Delete. Ko te whakakotahi he tuhituhinga whakakotahi (merge commit), ā kāore he mea e tuhia mātua (force-pushed). Mehemea he raru (conflict), whakatuwhera i te tono whakakotahi hei whakatau i te raru, te pātai rānei i a Nymbot kia whakaoho i te pāremata. Ko ngā nekehanga ki ngā raweke CI me ngā raweke mahi (workflow files) ka tatari tonu ki tō tirotiro. Ko te whakakore i ngā pāremata a Nymbot ka mutu i ngā pāremata i whakaritehia e tēnei akauneti, i whakakoteria rānei, i whakakore rānei te tono whakakotahi, me ngā kua riro atu te wiki me te kore he mea hei whakakotahi, engari e kore e mutu i tētahi kua neke mai i tērā wā. Whakakore i te kōwhiringa kia tuhia tika ki te pāremata mahi, he mahi kotahi mātua i te wā kotahi.
